content: वहः [वह्-कर्तरि अच्] .²1 Bearing, carrying, supporting <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 The shoulder of an ox. .²3 A vehicle or conveyance in general. .²4 Particularly, a horse; दर्शनस्पर्शनवहो घ्राणश्रवणवाहनः <ls>Mb. 12. 236. 10</ls>. .²5 Air, wind. .²6 A way, road. .²7 A male river (नद). .²8 A measure of four {%Droṇas%}. .²9 A current, stream. .²10 The breathing of a cow. .{@-हा@} a river, stream.
